Very disappointed.
Apr 2025 • Couples
After 6 weeks of all the varieties of food Da Nang has to offer my wife and I were missing our favorite. THAI. I found that Kin Kin was rated number 2. So we gave it a try. Our first visit was acceptable. I checked out the kitchen and was very impressed with its potential. ( I owned a very successful thai restaurant in the States for 8 years) The second visit was not so good. The service was extremely slow and items were not available. It was 1pm and not busy. The 3 visit was a disaster. They were out of thai tea and many juices onto the menu. Along with 3 of the 5 items we ordered. I really Can't imagine how they got their favorable reviews.

Good Thai Food In Danang
Jun 2019 • Couples
Got delivery from this place twice - Kin Kin delivers on time and their Thai food had an authentic taste. A few improvements here and there with their food. But it was more than acceptable and I will return again. 
Good Pad Thai, reasonable green curry, reasonable prawn cakes and we enjoyed the eggplant and basil the most.
Kin kin's prices of there food are also really good, you can have a few dishes to share with a few friends or family. I will be interested to try different dishes from this restaurant.
